verdict.rationale: Folk is a CRM with automation-adjacent features (webhooks, email sequences, MCP), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no automation version history, review workflow, or rollback. The X-API-Version header and endpoint deprecation policy concern REST API versioning, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
